notes.title: Fall in Love Visual Novel Festival has started!
notes.notes: [p]The first ever [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/fallinlovefestival2025"]Fall in Love Visual Novel Festival[/url] has started! It's a new festival focused on celebrating romance visual novels with over 200 visual novels from 100+ developers—including us![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45434831/0d99c3ac10af46640eadeb3a43c751f3dfc85370.png"][/img][/p][p]You can now play the demo for Lost Lune on Steam! We also have a brand new key art for the game, just for the festival.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45434831/c2bb0084974d26e9395e49472a93a779c9ec187e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Our boys love romance visual novels are also on sale, including Canvas Menagerie and Asphodelium![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2396400/Canvas_Menagerie/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3139260/Asphodelium/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We also have demos available for our other romance visual novels that are upcoming~[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072470/Crimson_Waves_on_the_Emerald_Sea_Amaranthine_Moon/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3563380/Maris_Magical_Deliveries"][/dynamiclink][/p]
